platform_info.name: WhatsApp group chat
platform_info.description: UU course variant of the WhatsApp group chat flow: members are anonymised (Member 1 is the participant) and message text is redacted. Requires a group chat with more than three members.

description.en: The messages in your group chat, with names replaced by Member 1 (you), Member 2, and so on, and every character of the message text replaced by *. You can search the table for a member or a date; the chart shows how many messages were sent per hour of the day. Dates are read day-first, so if your phone shows dates month-first (as in the US), some dates and the chart may be off.
description.nl: De berichten in je groepsgesprek, met namen vervangen door Member 1 (jij), Member 2, enzovoort, en elk teken van de berichttekst vervangen door *. Je kunt in de tabel zoeken op een lid of een datum; de grafiek toont hoeveel berichten er per uur van de dag zijn verstuurd. Datums worden gelezen met de dag eerst, dus als je telefoon de maand eerst toont (zoals in de VS), kunnen sommige datums en de grafiek afwijken.

title.en: Total chats per hour of the day
title.nl: Totaal chats per uur van de dag

documentation.summary: Each row is one message of the group chat: when it was sent, the anonymised sender, and the message text with every non-whitespace character replaced by '*'.

columns.Timestamp: Time the message was sent, on the phone's clock (ISO 8601, no time zone).
columns.Name: Anonymised sender: Member 1 is the participant.

title.en: The 100 most used emojis in the group
title.nl: De 100 meest gebruikte emoji's in de groep

description.en: Analysis of emoji frequency used by all members in the chat.
description.nl: Analyse van emoji-frequentie gebruikt door alle leden in de chat.

documentation.summary: Each row is one emoji used in the group chat, ranked by frequency across all members.

columns.Count: Total number of times this emoji was used.

title.en: Chat statistics per member (you are Member 1)

description.en: For each anonymised member of the group chat (you are Member 1): who reacted to them the most, who they reacted to the most, the number of messages and words they sent, and their most used emoji. A reaction is counted when someone else sends the next message.
description.nl: Voor elk geanonimiseerd lid van de groepschat (jij bent Member 1): wie het meest op hen reageerde, op wie zij het meest reageerden, het aantal verstuurde berichten en woorden, en hun meest gebruikte emoji. Een reactie telt wanneer iemand anders het volgende bericht stuurt.

documentation.summary: Each row is one messaging statistic for one anonymised member (Member 1 is the participant).

columns.Member: Anonymised member: Member 1 is the participant.
